# Weavergate Market garage - barrier and ticket codes

Code | Meaning | What to do
- P-02 | ticket not found at the barrier | take a fresh ticket on entry
- P-04 | ticket already validated | insert the original ticket, or press the help button at the barrier
- P-07 | exit grace period over | pay the overstay at the pay station

Lost tickets are charged the day rate at the pay station.
